windows.label: main
windows.title: Kevs Digital bOS
windows.initializationScript: if (window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__ && typeof window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.invoke === 'function') { window.POS_TAURI_BLE_PRINT = async (bytes) => { await window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.invoke('ble_print', { bytes: Array.from(bytes) }); }; }

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Kevs Digital bOS requires camera access to scan product barcodes.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Kevs Digital bOS requires microphone access.
